mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(nick_name,' (',user_name,')') FROM sys_user WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,accused_name,reason,status,create_time,reviewed_at FROM user_report WHERE reporter_id=#{owner} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id,reporter_name,accused_name,reason,status,version,create_time,reviewed_at FROM user_report status=#{status} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_report SET status=#{status},resolution=#{resolution},reviewed_by=#{actor},reviewed_at=NOW(6),pending_key=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING'
